name: Toba Fujihiko
source:
The shadow servant employed by the Futatsuguri family.
Fujihiko is a handsome youth who possesses an unwavering loyalty to Tamayo, his childhood friend.
From a young age, he honed his skills in ancient martial arts, studying under the guidance of Kumatsu Gyobu.

"That's why I want to protect Tamayo-sama from any danger."
